Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :news_status.eff_date is null
then
 message ('Err: Effective date must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :news_status.term_date is null
then
 message ('Err: Termination date must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :news_status.eff_date < trunc(sysdate)
then
 message ('Err: Effective date cannot be before today ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :news_status.term_date < trunc(sysdate)
then
 message ('Err: Termination date cannot be before today ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :news_status.term_date < :news_status.eff_date
then
 message ('Err: Termination date cannot be before the effective date');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;

 );

ProgramUnit.Name: FETCH_RECS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure fetch_recs is
begin
declare
 cursor c1 is
 select appl_id, news_id,
 serial_no, news_text
 from news_table
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and news_id = :ctrl_block_1.news_id
 order by serial_no;
begin
 go_block('news_table');
 clear_block(no_validate);
--
 for c1_rec in c1 loop
 create_record;
 :news_table.appl_id := c1_rec.appl_id;
 :news_table.news_id := c1_rec.news_id;
 :news_table.serial_no := :system.cursor_record;
 :news_table.news_text := c1_rec.news_text;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 first_record;
end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_SRLNO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure gen_srlno is
 recno number(6);
begin
 :news_table.appl_id := :ctrl_block_1.appl_id;
 :news_table.news_id := :ctrl_block_1.news_id;
 recno := :system.cursor_record;
 :news_table.serial_no := :system.cursor_record;
 while :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 loop
 :news_table.serial_no := :system.cursor_record;
 down;
 end loop;
 :news_table.serial_no := :system.cursor_record;
 go_record (recno);
end;
